title: Outdoor kitchens and canopies for private homes in Georgia
phrase: An outdoor kitchen is a canopy, work zone and utilities brought together into one place.
text: We plan the kitchen location, canopy structure and materials around the house, site and the client's wishes. We calculate snow load, build the base and connect water, drainage, electricity and lighting. Below is a real project: the client sent ChatGPT references, and we agreed the project and built the idea on site.
caseTitle: Outdoor kitchen with a large canopy
caseText: A real project with a large canopy, work zone, tile, metal structure, lighting and a dining table.

price.title: What the cost depends on
price.text: The cost depends on the base, canopy, metalwork, roofing, water, electricity, finishes, tiles, microcement, joinery and access to the site. We first review the site and clarify what is already in place and what needs to be built.

faq: Can you build only a canopy?
Yes. We first clarify whether it will later include a kitchen, table, barbecue, lighting or storage.
The material is selected according to the base, moisture, sun and use of the surface.
How much does an outdoor kitchen cost?
The exact cost depends on the base, canopy, metal, utilities, finishes and access to the site.
formText: Send photos, approximate dimensions and a short description of the kitchen or canopy you want.
